task.description: Replay the retained top-five Crossref and OpenAlex outputs from the same public artificial-intelligence-and-healthcare topic search, comparing exact DOI grouping with exact-title/multiple-DOI review surfacing.
task.claim_ceiling: Provider metadata only. The bounded snapshots are not a relevance review, recall estimate, source validation, duplicate determination, scientific support, or exhaustive search.

paired_comparison.interpretation: The new version preserves all exact-DOI grouping and unclustered results and surfaces one review-only exact-title/multiple-DOI candidate. It does not determine whether those records are duplicates, versions, or correct publications.

exact_title_different_doi_review_candida.normalized_title: transforming healthcare: the role of artificial intelligence in revolutionising patient care

outcome.claim_ceiling: This offline tool summarizes caller-supplied bounded Crossref, OpenAlex, and Europe PMC search receipts. Only exact normalized DOI equality creates a cross-index group. Identical normalized titles with distinct normalized DOIs are surfaced as review-only candidates and are never merged. Title similarity is not used. Provider query languages, corpora, ranking, timestamps, and hit counts are not comparable. Results do not establish relevance, completeness, source authenticity, article status, scientific support, or scientific validity.
